title: Detect a positive field weight that cannot be normalized
statement: For U2<0, same-site balanced Fock states have energy4U2 n²+O(n), so the uncut grand-canonical trace diverges. For U1>0,U2<0 the invertible residual propagation has a determinant pole reached by two uniform Gaussian modes; the local positive integral contains integral r^(1-2k)dr and diverges.

body: Conditional residual fields give B=exp(beta mu+aPhi+i bPsi)R, a,b>0. Any nonzero eigenvalue of R reaches1 at finitePhi,Psi. Positive Gaussian density at the root and Tonelli rule out normalization, even though exact roots have measure zero. Preserve the explicitly regularized finite-reference source and separate U2=0 regime.
